title: PPA: https://launchpad.net/~hectorcao/+archive/ubuntu/lp2163156
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index f2effd5..30f7308 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+nbd (1:3.26.1-6.1ubuntu2.1) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/t/initrd-boot: only attempt to create and activate a swapfile
+    if not running in a container (LP: #2163156)
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:07:31 +0200
+
 nbd (1:3.26.1-6.1ubuntu2) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * No-change mass rebuild for Ubuntu 26.04 (LP: #2132257)
diff --git a/debian/tests/initrd-boot b/debian/tests/initrd-boot
index 490cfe8..93de26b 100644
--- a/debian/tests/initrd-boot
+++ b/debian/tests/initrd-boot
@@ -27,15 +27,15 @@ ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -f "$TMPDIR"/id_rsa -N ""
 # to ensure our apt sources-and-preferences match the new VM's
 IMAGE="$TMPDIR"/nbd.img
 
-# Check if the architecture is armhf, and only attempt to enable swap if it's not
-if ! [ $(uname -m) = "armv7l" ]; then
+
+if systemd-detect-virt --container > /dev/null; then
+    echo "Skipping swap activation on LXC/LXD container"
+else
     # Allocate some swap
     fallocate -l 2G /swapfile
     chmod 600 /swapfile
     mkswap /swapfile
     swapon /swapfile
-else
-    echo "Skipping swap activation on armhf architecture"
 fi
 
 # If this fails locally, allocate more space to /tmp
